title: Zuri A, Zuri B and Corporate
who: You will be three people in turn, all on your own phone: the Zuri A office, the Zuri B office, and Corporate (the head office). Switch with 🔄 Try another job on the Me page; the script tells you when. Everything is pretend and stays on your phone. The big question: can Zuri A see Zuri B's numbers? It should not. If you tap 🧹 Start over (pretend company) in the middle, the bill and cash you made are wiped — go back to session 1. That is our fault, not yours.

sessions.title: You are Zuri A
sessions.intro: Zuri A's office. Enter some money and check you only ever see A.

steps.do: Open the Me page. Tap 🧹 Start over (pretend company), then OK. Then tap 🔄 Try another job and pick 🅰️ Zuri A office.
steps.see: The top of the page says Anne Wairimu (Zuri A office). A small badge says Zuri A.

steps.do: Look at the area box at the top, next to the name. Tap it.
steps.see: It shows ONLY Zuri A and it is locked. There is no 'All areas' and no Zuri B. If you can pick Zuri B or All areas, that is a real fault — tell us.
steps.tip: This is the main promise of the three positions.

steps.do: Tap 💰 Money, then ✍️ Record, then record cash coming in. Area is Zuri A. Amount 12000. From: Test cash A. Tap Save cash in.
steps.see: It saves. The Area box offered only Zuri A.

steps.do: Record an expense. Payee: ZZ Test Hardware A. Amount 3500. Tap Save expense.
steps.see: It saves under Zuri A. Again the Area box offered only Zuri A.

steps.do: Open Bills. Add a bill: name ZZ Test Bill A, amount 5000, due day 28. Tap Add bill.
steps.see: The bill appears in the list. Look at the other bills: every one is a Zuri A bill. You should see no Zuri B bills such as Pole rent or Bayobab backhaul. If you do, tell us — that is a real fault.

steps.do: Go to the Money page and read the figures at the top. Write down the cash-in total.
steps.see: The heading says Money · Zuri A. The numbers are Zuri A's alone.

sessions.title: You are Zuri B
sessions.intro: Zuri B's office. Check A's things are hidden from you.

steps.do: Tap 🔄 Try another job and pick 🅱️ Zuri B office.
steps.see: The top of the page says Baraka Mutua (Zuri B office), and Zuri B. It is a different company view from A.
You see only Zuri B bills. ZZ Test Bill A is NOT there. If Zuri A's bill shows here, that is a real fault — tell us.
steps.tip: Check the bill you made as A is hidden.

steps.do: Record cash in. Amount 9000. From: Test cash B. Tap Save cash in. The Area box should offer only Zuri B.
Read the figures at the top of Money.
steps.see: The heading says Money · Zuri B. The cash-in total does NOT include Zuri A's 12000.
You see Zuri B customers only. If you can find a Zuri A customer, tell us.

sessions.title: You are Corporate
sessions.intro: The head office. See both areas added together, and pay a bill.

steps.do: Tap 🔄 Try another job and pick ⭐ Partner / admin. This is Corporate, the head office.
steps.see: The top of the page says Jerry (owner) · Admin.

steps.do: Look at the area box at the top. Tap it.
steps.see: It offers All areas, Zuri A and Zuri B. Choose All areas.

steps.do: Open Money with All areas chosen.
steps.see: The heading says Money · all areas. The page shows a section for Zuri A and one for Zuri B, side by side.
You see ZZ Test Bill A (from Zuri A) AND the Zuri B bills, all in one list.

steps.do: Pay a bill from here. Tap 💸 Pay on ZZ Test Bill A and pay the whole 5000. Choose how it was paid and save.
steps.see: The bill shows paid 5,000 and owing 0. Corporate paid it for Zuri A.
steps.tip: Corporate pays the bills, so this must work for an area that is not 'yours'.

steps.do: Now choose Zuri A only in the area box, then Zuri B only, then All areas again.
steps.see: Zuri A shows A's figures, Zuri B shows B's, and All areas is the two together. Add A and B by hand — does it match All areas?
steps.tip: Tell us the three cash-in numbers you saw.

steps.do: Look at Home with All areas chosen. Is there a plain picture of how the company is doing?
steps.see: You can see what matters across both areas without opening each one. Tell us what you wish it showed that it does not.
